description_for_human: Onchain loyalty platform on Base Network. Businesses launch branded rewards in minutes. Customers earn real value with every purchase. AI agents automate the rest.
description_for_model: Loyal Spark is an onchain loyalty-as-a-service protocol on Base L2. Use it to create ERC-20 loyalty programs, mint tokens to customer wallets, manage rewards catalogs, trade tokens on a P2P escrow marketplace, redeem rewards for vouchers, and manage customer tiers. Supports REST API (agent-api, 25 authenticated routes + 1 public), MCP Server (32 merchant tools on loyalty-mcp, 14 recipient tools on recipient-loyalty-mcp), and pay-per-request gateways (MPP with pathUSD, x402 v2 with USDC on Base). Paid MCP: POST x402-gateway/mcp-tools/<tool_name> with JSON-RPC tools/call and x-api-key after payment; tool parameters: see repo supabase/functions/_shared/mcp-bazaar-tools.ts. Agents get their own Coinbase MPC wallets for autonomous onchain operations. Builder Code bc_wdmnog7m on Base (chain ID 8453).
